readme: What this is
Same frame as the 72 Snack Collection model: Current State (what sells today), plus Retailer Expansion and SKU Expansion as incremental tabs, rolling to Overall. Retail $ at shelf.
Current State

Whole Foods (about 530 US doors) plus Faire independents (about 5 percent of Vosges dollars). 7 Exotic bars, 3 oz, in the deli set: Raw Honey Cacao, Black Salt Caramel, Pink Salt Caramel, Matcha, Banana Coconut, Mo's Bacon, Turmeric Ginger. Confirmed on wholefoodsmarket.com and Amazon/Whole Foods 2026-11-07.
Retailer Expansion

The WS27 pouch into the launch plan tiers. Whole Foods expands first: 3 SKUs in Mar-27, the other 2 in Jun-27. Sprouts, the UNFI unlocks and the KeHE unlocks start once the full set exists (Jun-27). Hold stays at zero. Expected doors = doors x tier hit rate. Launch month = later of the tier gate and review month + pitch offset + ship lag.
Why growth is the pouch

Steve 2026-11-10: the bars sell at Whole Foods because they sit in the deli set, not the chocolate set. Most retailers will not give a bar that spot, and in the candy aisle a 9.99 bar is the most expensive by about 3 dollars. So bars are held flat as the existing business and every retailer and SKU expansion is the pouch.
SKU Expansion
Wave 2 (Peanut Butter Bonbons, Hazelnut Praline, Toffee Bites) and the shelf-stable truffle pouch, stairstepped into the Tier 1 pouch doors that exist when each is ready.
Overall
Every number is a link or a sum. Also backs out 40 retailer / 15 distributor to brand revenue and checks it against the intake FDM number.
Whole Foods Plan / Vol
Blank Pack Love in-store templates for the Whole Foods program, built against the recommended Trade + Marketing.
Color key
Blue = input. Gold fill = a guess to replace with real data. Black = formula. Green = pulled from another tab.
Biggest guesses
Bar and pouch velocity (no SPINS yet), Whole Foods door count, tier hit rates and spend %, Sprouts door count, WS27 timing. Swap in SPINS or the Whole Foods vendor report and the whole model moves.
Not modeled
Pouch cannibalizing bars at Whole Foods; Amazon/DTC/corporate gifting; Faire independents; private label cups (separate lane, see the Private Label grid).

dashboard.footer_note: Calendar 2027, Jan to Dec, same frame as 72. Headline tile is gross sales (what Vosges invoices, after 40 retailer / 15 distributor; Faire at keystone); retail $ at shelf is the sub-line. Trade, marketing and contribution margin show $ and % of gross sales. P&L: gross sales, less trade = net sales, less COGS (margin calculator ceilings: bar 2.85, pouch 2.56) = gross profit, less marketing = contribution margin, before overhead. Existing business is 2.75M Vosges dollars today (Vosges, 2026-11-10): about 95 percent Whole Foods and 5 percent Faire independents (Steve's split). Faire runs keystone with no distributor and about 15 percent commission. Whole Foods: 7 Exotic bars, 3 oz, deli set, 530 US doors assumed (all of them, the conservative per-store read; bars confirmed on wholefoodsmarket.com in Chicago and SoCal 2026-11-07, authorized count from Andy pending). Retailer Expansion: Whole Foods takes 3 pouch SKUs in Mar-27 and 2 more in Jun-27; Sprouts, UNFI and KeHE accounts start Jun-27 with the full set, at tier hit rates (Whole Foods and Sprouts 75%); Hold at zero. No bar expansion: bars only win in a non-chocolate set like the Whole Foods deli; in the candy aisle they would be the priciest bar by about 3 dollars, so retail growth is the pouch. SKU Expansion stairsteps wave 2 into the Tier 1 pouch doors. Gold cells are the guesses: velocity (bars 2.95 calibrated to the Whole Foods share of the 2.75M at 530 doors, launch pouches 3.0, wave 2 pouches 2.0 u/s/w; no SPINS yet), Whole Foods door count, Whole Foods vs Faire split, Sprouts doors, tier hit rates and spend %, WS27 timing. Marketing returns 1.1x in retail $ at shelf, incremental (Vosges runs no marketing today). Pouch cannibalization of bars is not modeled. Download the workbook for formulas and the Whole Foods Plan / Vol templates.

retailer_card.label: Retailer Expansion: WS27 pouch (prospective, incremental)
retailer_card.note: Whole Foods expands first: 3 pouch SKUs in Mar-27 (in development, maybe sooner), the other 2 in Jun-27, at 75% odds. Pouch velocity 3.0 u/s/w, the conservative case, at or just above the bars (2.95); upside 3.5. Growth is the pouch: bars only win in a non-chocolate set like the Whole Foods deli. Every other account waits for the full set and starts Jun-27: Sprouts, the UNFI unlocks (Fresh Market, Natural Grocers, NCG co-ops, Plum, Bristol Farms, PCC, Heinen's, Market of Choice and 12 premium independents on the Whole Foods DCs) and the KeHE unlocks if Sprouts lands (Gelson's, Central Market, Lassen's, Erewhon halo, Fresh Thyme watch). Kroger, H-E-B, Wegmans, Woodman's, Jewel-Osco, Mariano's sit in Hold at zero: private label conversation only.

sku_card.label: SKU / TDP Expansion: wave 2 (prospective, incremental)

The truffle pouch and Espresso fall into 2028. Not modeled: refrigerated, grocery gifting boxes, bark, branded PB cups (cups are private label).

mret_card.label: Marketing return (1.1x marketing $ at shelf, incremental)
mret_card.note: Steve 2026-11-10: every marketing dollar returns 1.1 dollars at shelf (SRP basis), about 314K retail, which is about 160K to Vosges after retailer and distributor margin. On top of the velocity base; Vosges runs no marketing today. Spend sits in the other cards; this is the sales it brings back.

marketing_return.label: Marketing return: retail $ at shelf per $1 of marketing
marketing_return.note: Steve 2026-11-10: marketing $ comes back at 1.1x in retail $ (SRP basis). Incremental on top of the velocity base, since Vosges runs no marketing today. Spread by month with base revenue; same waterfall and blended COGS, no trade on top.
